summary: Trivial __thiscall forwarding wrapper: dereferences the single member at this+0x0 and passes it to FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF), returning that call's result. A generic object-release shim with no state of its own.

Return the result of FreeWrapper_7bcf unchanged.
